videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: 25-40% of weight lost on Ozempic is muscle that does not return after stopping; regained weight is mostly fat, with persistent risks of nutritional deficiencies and gastroparesis.
content: Most GLP-1 action is brain-mediated hunger suppression plus slowed digestion
Resistance training plus leucine-rich animal protein helps preserve muscle
Other lasting issues: acid reflux, vision loss, hair loss, pancreatitis
videos.watch_why: Concrete percentages and mechanisms on muscle loss vs fat regain; actionable mitigation steps, not generic warning.

videos.title: IPCON PPA-CF vs PPA-GF: One Is the Strongest Filament I've Ever Tested
videos.point: IPCON PPA-GF exceeds 400 kg in vertical tensile test and shows superior Z-axis strength when printed slower than the CF version.
content: Compared brittleness, moisture, shrinkage, tensile, layer adhesion, shear, torsion, bending, impact, creep
Horizontal torsion: CF slightly stronger; bending strength higher for CF
Print speed critical for strength even if spec is 250 mm/s
videos.watch_why: Quantitative test results across multiple axes; practical print-speed caveat for shop use.

videos.title: Cast Iron Leaving Black Residue? It's Not Your Seasoning
videos.point: Black residue on cast iron is usually carbonized food from too-high heat, not a failed seasoning layer.
content: Wipe while warm shows loose carbon and residual oil
Fix with soap wash, salt abrasion, lower heat, thin oil only if needed
No need to strip; soap does not remove polymerized seasoning
videos.watch_why: Clear mechanism and cleaning steps that prevent unnecessary pan stripping.

content: Tin droplet size of white blood cell shot at 250 km/h
Mirrors so smooth that Earth-scale version has bumps thinner than a playing card
Overlay accuracy to five atoms while parts accelerate over 20 Gs
videos.watch_why: Detailed mechanism of the most complex commercial machine; concrete numbers on scale and precision.
